data.summary:
**When:** Any phase, after an enemy unit finishes a move up to 8" from any [Cult Ambush](vsdata:ability/genestealer-cults.cult-ambush) marker of yours, before such markers are removed.

**Target:** A [Cult Ambush](vsdata:ability/genestealer-cults.cult-ambush) marker of yours that the enemy unit ended its move up to 8" from.

**Effect:** You can set the marker up again anywhere on the battlefield more than 8" horizontally from every enemy unit.
